evidence.detail:
Chosen with Nick as the third high-trust reference. Less established evidence and proximity to medium remain explicit; there is no fourth tier.

Patent examples mainly report shine, softness and combability with other accompanying formulations. No inspected quantitative structural / strength result for the exact retail treatment.

An original longer-use review reports months of weekly use, softer hair and easier application. Affiliate context and concurrent care are disclosed. Abbey's discount code is verified, not an exact efficacy verdict.

Targeted restorative treatment with recurring use.

Historical v0.3 evidence observations (owner grades and selected Redken source now follow the later owner decision):

E07 reports qualitative shine, softness, combability and frizz with conditioning companions different from the retail concentrate; those endpoints do not establish structural reinforcement.

N12 reports months of weekly use on coloured hair with softness and easier application, but also potential weight during extended wear or incomplete washing. Concurrent product-line/routine use confounds attribution.

N09 exposes routine inclusion metadata only, not a readable first-person benefit, duration or verdict. N08's discount code is promotional context, not efficacy evidence.

No inspectable quantitative exact-retail reinforcement report was found in the bounded search; that search result is not proof no effect or no such report exists.

N12 is Kara's original article dated 2026-04-12, months of weekly use on coloured hair, affiliate links disclosed; hair-science expertise is not verified. One report is not multiple independent trials.

N08 verifies Abbey Yung's own epres code, not payment; N09 original video/transcript was inaccessible. No repeated use or positive verdict is inferred from either.

E07 is inventor/patent-holder material, not independent retail validation. Unsupported mechanism/origin/nail statements in N12 are excluded.

N05 resolves the intended-bottle finished amount and up-to-two-month mixed-product use period. It does not authorize a universal custom-bottle ratio, doubled dose or physical local kit identity.

Optional creator access is not universally mandatory; here the remaining lack of a sufficient benefit-specific empirical/experience route is consequential.

limitations: E07 reports qualitative shine, softness, combability and frizz with conditioning companions different from the retail concentrate; those endpoints do not establish structural reinforcement.

Patent examples mainly report shine, softness and combability with other accompanying formulations. No inspected quantitative structural / strength result for the exact retail treatment.

Targeted restorative treatment with recurring use.

Historical v0.3 evidence observations (owner grades and selected Redken source now follow the later owner decision):

E07 reports qualitative shine, softness, combability and frizz with conditioning companions different from the retail concentrate; those endpoints do not establish structural reinforcement.

N12 reports months of weekly use on coloured hair with softness and easier application, but also potential weight during extended wear or incomplete washing. Concurrent product-line/routine use confounds attribution.

N09 exposes routine inclusion metadata only, not a readable first-person benefit, duration or verdict. N08's discount code is promotional context, not efficacy evidence.

No inspectable quantitative exact-retail reinforcement report was found in the bounded search; that search result is not proof no effect or no such report exists.

N12 is Kara's original article dated 2026-04-12, months of weekly use on coloured hair, affiliate links disclosed; hair-science expertise is not verified. One report is not multiple independent trials.

N08 verifies Abbey Yung's own epres code, not payment; N09 original video/transcript was inaccessible. No repeated use or positive verdict is inferred from either.

E07 is inventor/patent-holder material, not independent retail validation. Unsupported mechanism/origin/nail statements in N12 are excluded.

N05 resolves the intended-bottle finished amount and up-to-two-month mixed-product use period. It does not authorize a universal custom-bottle ratio, doubled dose or physical local kit identity.

Optional creator access is not universally mandatory; here the remaining lack of a sufficient benefit-specific empirical/experience route is consequential.

dilution.methodDe: Mit Wasser bis zum vorgesehenen Endvolumen auffüllen und mischen.

exactSteps.copyDe: 1 Fläschchen in der vorgesehenen Herstellerflasche mit Wasser auf 150 ml fertige Mischung auffüllen und mischen.
Das Haar vollständig benetzen. Auf das trockene, ungewaschene Haar geben und im Haar verteilen.
Mindestens 10 Minuten einwirken lassen. Auch über Nacht möglich.
Anschließend wie gewohnt mit Shampoo waschen und pflegen.
Danach kannst du deinen üblichen Conditioner verwenden und diesen wie gewohnt ausspülen. Wenn du keine zusätzliche Pflege brauchst, lässt du diesen Schritt weg.
